title: Mirabel and the Witness
author: S. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Orsen Dunmore, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
